name: reportgen-pip-constraints
instruction:
The monthly report tool in /app/reportgen does not run: its virtualenv /app/venv has none of its dependencies. Install them into /app/venv from the offline wheelhouse with

    cd /app/reportgen && /app/venv/bin/pip install --no-index --find-links /opt/wheelhouse -r requirements.txt -c constraints.txt

and fix requirements.txt and constraints.txt where they are wrong, so that the same command also succeeds in a fresh Python 3.11 venv and gives a working tool (see /app/reportgen/README.md). Do not change the reportgen code (reportgen/ and bin/) or the wheelhouse. Then:
- write the report for /data/orders.csv to /app/out/monthly.txt with `/app/reportgen/bin/reportgen /data/orders.csv -o /app/out/monthly.txt`;
- record the exact installed versions in /app/reportgen/requirements.lock (pip freeze format, one `name==version` per line).

The machine has no network.
